title: fix(platform-objects): Setup Create User marks Email required while phone sign-in is off
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XMQYxWuFJTUDhuJ14KLeVrk)_

Fixes #28280

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Setup → 用户 → 创建用户：未开启手机号登录（默认）时，「邮箱」在提交前就带必填星标，留空会在对话框里直接拦下；开启手机号登录时，邮箱仍是可选，旁边是手机号。控制台还没拿到 `/auth/config` 的应答时（加载中或请求失败），邮箱不带标记，和 main 上一样。
- **为什么改**：服务器在未开启手机号登录时拒收空邮箱（400 "Email is required"），但对话框把邮箱画成可选，管理员只有提交后才知道。#28649 已能在提交后标出服务器点名的字段，这张卡补上提交前的标记。
- **风险与回滚**：中低。`sys_user.create_user` 的邮箱参数拆成两个（同一字段，按 `features.phoneNumber` 各自显隐，对话框只画并只提交显示的那个）。为此动作门的参数校验 `validateActionParams` 改了一处语义：同名参数声明多次时，只有每一处都必填才算必填，值形状按第一处（以前是最后一处说了算，会让 REST 动作门把只填手机号的创建拒成 400）。仓库、示例和 hotcrm 里没有别的动作重复声明参数名，所以别处行为不变。外加 `public-auth-features.ts` 登记一条路径。纯 revert 即可回滚。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts`（同名合并那一行）；`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`（两个邮箱参数的顺序与 `visible`）；`packages/runtime/src/domains/api-action-create-user-email-param.test.ts`（经真实 REST 动作门的三条路径）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/api-action-create-user-email-param.test.ts`，预期 5 例全绿（只填手机号的创建能到达接口；空邮箱由接口自己答 400 "Email is required"）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（含 `packages/spec` 路径的 Contract review）。

## What changes

- **`sys_user.create_user` declares two params on the one `email` field** (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`). A param's `required` is a static boolean, and the endpoint requires the email only while phone sign-in is off, so:
  - first `{ field: 'email', required: false, requiresFeature: 'phoneNumber' }`, which lowers to `features.phoneNumber == true`;
  - then `{ field: 'email', required: true, visible: 'has(features.phoneNumber) && features.phoneNumber != true' }`.
  The console collects and submits only the params whose gate says yes (`filterVisibleParams`), so exactly one Email input renders. The rendered order is unchanged: Email, then Phone Number when it shows, then Name.
- **The action doors judge a twice-declared name by every declaration** (`packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts`, under the one-PR exception the seat extended to this file). `validateActionParams`, which `enforceActionParams` runs on the REST action route and the MCP `run_action` bridge before the handler, keyed params by name with the LAST declaration winning, so the required second Email param made the REST door refuse a phone-only create (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR` "Action param \"email\" is required"). A name declared more than once is now required only when EVERY declaration is, and its value shape is the FIRST declaration's; unknown-key handling is unchanged. The door reads no `visible` or `features`, so the endpoint stays the judge of a blank email.
- **The registry** (`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`): `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.phoneNumber.gatedInputs` books `sys_user.actions.create_user.params.email`. The row's notes say the path stands for two params, the second negatively gated, and the module and `gatedInputs` docblocks say a param path resolves to the first param on its field and the gate is checked as a conjunct. No registry model change and no required-when predicate, as ruled.
- **The guard's header** (`packages/platform-objects/src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts`) states that this one booked path stands for two params, one of them negatively gated. The guard's logic is untouched.
- **Tests**: a platform-objects pin that evaluates the declared gates through the canonical CEL engine under the console's show rule; an app-shell test that opens Create User through the console runtime with the served `features`; a runtime test that drives the real REST action route with the real `SysUser` declaration; two `validateActionParams` cases in `action-params.test.ts`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28280-create-user-email-required-mark.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor (the semantic change to a twice-declared param's `required` at the doors) and `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch. Both packages ship `dist`, and the built `dist` of each carries the change.

<details><summary>The REST action door (runtime), red first and the merge ablated</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/api-action-create-user-email-param.test.ts`, driving `HttpDispatcher.handleActions('/sys_user/create_user', 'POST', …)` over the `api-action-forward.test.ts` recording target, with the real `SysUser` from `@objectstack/platform-objects/identity`:

- the declaration carries two email params, `[false, true]`;
- phone-only `{ phoneNumber, name }` passes the door and is forwarded to `/api/v1/auth/admin/create-user`;
- a blank email passes the door; the caller gets the ENDPOINT's `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` "Email is required" with its `fields`, relayed whole (the door does not refuse it);
- an email is forwarded with it;
- control: a non-string email is still refused at the door (value shape from the first declaration).

Red first, with `packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts` at 2310b302 and spec rebuilt: `× phone-only … reaches the endpoint` with `{"code":"VALIDATION_ERROR","message":"Invalid action params: Action param \"email\" is required","httpStatus":400}`, `× blank email …` (the seat's finding). That run was on a six-case draft: 3 failed / 3 passed, the third an MCP case that failed on the system-object exposure refusal instead and was dropped (see below). Spec unit cases: 2 failed / 33 passed.

Merge ablated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (`declared.set(p.name, p)`, last wins), spec rebuilt, `dist` hits of the merge 0: door test 2 failed / 3 passed, spec cases 2 failed / 33 passed. Restored to the HEAD blob (`git diff HEAD` empty), rebuilt, `dist` hits 1: 5/5 and 35/35.

The MCP bridge is not driven for this action: `create_user` declares no `ai.exposed`, so `run_action` refuses it as a system-object action before any param check (measured). Both doors call the same `enforceActionParams`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

| Leg | Mutation | Reading |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | source: the required Email param made `required: false` | `× phone sign-in off: one Email input, and it is required` · 1 failed / 115 passed |
| A2 | source: `has(features.phoneNumber) &&` dropped (bare `features.phoneNumber != true`) | `× no served flag …: one Email input, optional` · 1 failed / 114 passed |
| A3 | source: the two Email params swapped (required first) | `× the first Email param carries the canonical phoneNumber gate …` and the guard's forward row `× sys_user.actions.create_user.params.email is gated on phoneNumber` · 2 failed / 114 passed |
| U1 | ui mirror: the required param made optional | `× phone sign-in off: … required mark …` · 1 failed / 3 passed |
| U2 | ui mirror: bare `features.phoneNumber != true` | `× no served flag …` · 1 failed / 3 passed |

The platform-objects pin imports the object from `src/` (relative import), and ui vitest aliases `@object-ui/*` to `src/`, so no leg needed a rebuild. A3 confirms the order matters: the forward guard resolves the path to the first param on the field.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **One reading beyond the order's literal.** The order spelled the required param's gate `features.phoneNumber != true`. Measured (A2, U2): while the console holds no served flag (its `features` is `{}` until `/auth/config` answers, and stays `{}` if that fetch fails) both gates fault on the absent key, and the dialog shows a param whose gate faults, so two Email inputs render. The `has(features.phoneNumber) &&` term keeps the required param hidden then, and Email stays optional as it was. The precedent spelling is `sys-user.page.ts`'s `has(features.twoFactor) && features.twoFactor == true`. The first, optional param keeps the canonical gate the guard wants.
- **The endpoint is unchanged**: it still refuses a blank email with phone sign-in off; no server file is in this diff.
- **Census for the semantic change**: an AST scan of every `params` / `actionParams` array literal in this repository (430 arrays, `ui/` and `examples/` included) and in hotcrm `origin/main` (7 arrays), plus the 2 JSON params arrays, finds no name declared twice except `create_user`'s `email`. No existing action relied on last-wins.
- **The reverse guard** has three `email` rows (one per `features.phoneNumber` reference across the two params), all booked by the one path.
- The reverse guard's red without the booking was measured on the card (2 failed) and is not re-run here.
